tags.v5uru: Godan verb - Uru old class verb (old form of Eru)
tags.v2w-s: Nidan verb (lower class) with 'u' ending and 'we' conjugation (archaic)
tags.X: rude or X-rated term (not displayed in educational software)
tags.uk: word usually written using kana alone
tags.given: given name or forename, gender not specified
tags.vr: irregular ru verb, plain form ends with -ri
tags.vs: noun or participle which takes the aux. verb suru
tags.vz: Ichidan verb - zuru verb (alternative form of -jiru verbs)
tags.work: work of art, literature, music, etc. name
tags.vs-c: su verb - precursor to the modern suru
tags.adj-no: nouns which may take the genitive case particle 'no'
tags.person: full name of a particular person
tags.oK: word containing out-dated kanji or kanji usage
tags.gikun: gikun (meaning as reading) or jukujikun (special kanji reading)
